title: [Fabric] Clean up test events, app naming, authentication and telemetry
summary: The Fabric mirroring app was refactored to make test events internal, renamed for clarity, and updated to use standard audit logging instead of custom telemetry events.
key_points: Five test-only events in Fabric Platform Mgt made internal with test app retaining access
App renamed to 'Business Central Mirroring to Fabric (preview)' for better clarity
Replaced pseudo-audit telemetry with System.Telemetry's Audit Log.LogAuditMessage
Removed unused Key Vault client-ID lookup and related code after dependency integration
Diagnostic event IDs maintained at direct LogMessage calls for proper event tracking
